prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Last year when I was in Shanghai, I remember I kept joking that I should’ve just rented a car the whole time instead of bouncing between taxis and the metro.
And then later I went to Chengdu too—same story there, except the parking situation was what everyone kept warning me about.
My coworker Wu Qian told me she’d already arranged a Toyota Corolla under her name for a pickup date of 2025-05-15, so I didn’t have to think about it.
She said the rental was for 6 days total, and honestly it sounded like it made the whole trip way smoother.
In Chengdu, my friend had already set up overnight parking at Chunxi Road IFS Parking starting 2025-04-02 17:00 for 12 hours—plate was 沪B67890, and the contact phone they used was 13898776655.
